description: This Java class 'PayPalServices' provides methods for integrating with PayPal's NVP API, including setting up express checkout, updating checkout details, performing transactions like authorization, capture, void, refund, and handling related data such as customer addresses and payment methods within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PayPalServices.TokenWrapper
classes.description: A serializable wrapper class for PayPal checkout tokens, with overridden equals and hashCode methods for use as map keys.

methods.name: setExpressCheckout
methods.description: Initializes a PayPal express checkout session, sets cart details, and retrieves a checkout token from PayPal.

methods.name: payPalCheckoutUpdate
methods.description: Updates shipping and address details during PayPal checkout, creates necessary address and contact records, and responds with shipping options.

methods.name: getExpressCheckout
methods.description: Retrieves details of an ongoing PayPal express checkout, creates customer and address records if needed, and prepares the cart for payment.

methods.name: doExpressCheckout
methods.description: Completes the PayPal express checkout process, capturing transaction details and updating payment method records.

methods.name: doAuthorization
methods.description: Performs a PayPal authorization transaction for a given order and amount.

methods.name: doCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized PayPal transaction.

methods.name: doVoid
methods.description: Voids a PayPal authorization or transaction.

methods.name: doRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a captured PayPal transaction.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodGatewayPayPal
methods.description: Retrieves the PayPal payment gateway configuration based on context, such as product store or order.

methods.name: sendNVPRequest
methods.description: Sends an NVP request to PayPal and returns the decoded response.

methods.name: getCountryGeoIdFromGeoCode
methods.description: Fetches the geographic ID for a country based on its geo code.

methods.name: parseStateProvinceGeoId
methods.description: Determines the geo ID for a state or province based on PayPal's returned code and country.
